```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"It is critical that the United States has a highly trained and skilled workforce.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nine federal agencies currently run 47 retraining programs at a total cost of $18 billion annually with dismal results.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Both the trainees in those programs and the taxpayers who fund them deserve better.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We propose consolidation of those programs into State block grants so that training can be coordinated with local schools and employers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"That consolidation will be critically important if States establish Personal Reemployment Accounts, letting trainees direct resources in ways that will steer them toward long-term employment, especially through on-the-job training with participating employers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We can accelerate the process of restoring the domestic economy and reclaiming the country's traditional position of dominance in international trade by a policy of strategic immigration, granting more work visas to holders of advanced degrees in science, technology, engineering, and math from other nations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Highly educated immigrants can assist in creating new services and products.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Foreign students who graduate from an American university with an advanced degree in science, technology, engineering or math should be encouraged to remain here and contribute to economic prosperity and job creation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Highly skilled, English-speaking, and integrated into their communities, foreign students are too valuable a resource to lose.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We should encourage the world's innovators and inventors to create the common future and their permanent homes here in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
